name: E-commerce Ad
description: Dynamically plan ad shots from the product and its selling points, generate product anchors, ad visuals, video clips and voiceover, and compose them automatically.

planning.planning_notes: Decide the number of shots dynamically from the user goal; generate a product anchor first when there is no product image, and use the product image as the consistency reference when there is one.
planning.prompt_guide: Highlight the product selling points, usage scenarios, brand tone and a clear call to action, keeping the product appearance consistent across all shots.
conduct_rules: Dynamically decide the number of nodes and their dependencies from the user goal
Use only the capabilities declared in allowed_recipe_ids
Generate and confirm the dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes

rating_bands.description: Fully meets the user goal and the workflow can be executed
Core flow is complete; a few non-critical adjustments are allowed
Missing key stages or incomplete dependencies

domain_constraints: The workflow must match the user goal and keep the input assets consistent
